title: Remnant
text:
Remnant is a gem tag for skills which create Remnants, objects which can be picked up by moving near them.


== Mechanics and Interactions ==
Stats worded as "when you collect a Remnant" do not give you the benefits of these stats when an Ally shares the effects of a Remnant with you.
